en.Gracias por usar PricePeek. Estos términ: Thank you for using PricePeek. These terms describe the basic rules for accessing and using the platform, its price comparison tools, and account features. By browsing the site or creating an account, you agree to these terms.
en.PricePeek es un servicio que reúne infor: PricePeek is a service that brings together product and price information published by stores to make it easier to view and compare. PricePeek does not sell products, process payments, manage deliveries, or represent the stores featured on the platform.
en.Los precios, la disponibilidad, las cara: Prices, availability, features, images, and promotions may change and may contain errors or be out of date. This information is provided for guidance only; it is not an offer to sell and does not guarantee that a product is available at the displayed price.
en.Antes de comprar, confirme el precio fin: Before buying, confirm the final price, taxes, shipping costs, promotion terms, and availability directly with the store. Any purchase is made between you and the store under that store's terms.
en.Al crear una cuenta, usted se compromete: When creating an account, you agree to provide accurate information, keep it up to date, and protect your credentials. Actions taken through your account will be attributed to you. If you suspect someone accessed it without authorization, change your password and notify the project team.
en.Puede solicitar la eliminación de su cue: You may request deletion of your account using the options available in your profile. PricePeek may restrict or suspend accounts that violate these terms or affect the platform's safe operation.
en.La lista de deseos permite guardar produ: The wishlist lets you save products and, when available, set a target price, store, or alert. Alerts depend on PricePeek receiving and processing up-to-date information. Therefore, we do not guarantee that alerts will be immediate, sent for every change, or that the price will still be valid when you receive one.
en.Usted es responsable del contenido que p: You are responsible for the content you post. Reviews and photos must be relevant, respectful, and based on a genuine experience. Do not post content that is illegal, misleading, discriminatory, defamatory, invasive of privacy, unsolicited promotional material, or infringing on others' rights.
en.Al publicar contenido, usted conserva su: By posting content, you retain your rights and grant PricePeek a free, non-exclusive, limited license to host, display, and reproduce it on the platform to provide its features. You may edit or delete your reviews using the available options. PricePeek may review reports and remove content that violates these terms.
en.Usted acepta no interferir con la plataf: You agree not to interfere with the platform, attempt to access other people's accounts or systems, introduce harmful code, automatically extract information in a way that harms the service, or use PricePeek to violate the law or others' rights.
en.PricePeek se ofrece como herramienta inf: PricePeek is provided as an informational tool and may be changed, interrupted, or discontinued.
